review.tagline: Claude Code and Codex skill that builds promo videos with Remotion
review.summary: An agent skill for Claude Code and Codex that captures your product's real pages, picks from 150 shots (124 recipe cards), and renders a 1920x1080, 30 fps MP4 using Remotion. Every frame is drawn by code from your screenshots and copy, so the output is a editable React project. It also adds sound design and beat sync, opens a browser-based editor (Motion Workbench), and can export a JianYing draft.
review.audience: Developers who want agent-made, code-editable product promo videos
strengths: Output is a full Remotion project, so every shot stays editable React code
Ships 124 recipe cards, 149 SFX and 5 BGM tracks, plus a runnable template
Motion Workbench edits copy, timing and shots after delivery; preview and render match
Optional JianYing draft export and Upload-Post social publishing
weaknesses: Tested on macOS; headless Linux needs three workarounds (concurrency, chrome-headless-shell, CDN)
Remotion has its own license; companies may need a paid one
Only Claude Code and Codex are targeted; other agents are not mentioned
JianYing export verified only on macOS; Windows installer untested
needs: Needs Node.js and npm, Remotion, ffmpeg / ffprobe, uv (BGM beat analysis only), puppeteer (page capture only)
